about: What's New feed shown in the game (modules/news.js). Newest first is not required: the game sorts by date + version. Fields: id (unique), date YYYY-MM-DD, version, title, items[], big (highlighted card), image (optional, relative path like assets/ui/news/x.jpg). Written by the release manager (qa/release) when a big feature goes live.

entries.title: Killcam 2.0
items: See your death through your killer's eyes: their gun, their scope, their aim
Slow motion on the final shot, banner with their weapon and HP left
Final killcam at the end of every match
Press Space to skip

entries.title: The Shop and Nine Shards
items: Earn Nine Shards by playing matches and daily missions
Spend them on soldier skins and gun skins in the new Shop

entries.title: Gun skins
items: New finishes for your weapons
Pick a skin for each gun

entries.title: Guns that look like they fire
items: Muzzle flashes now differ by gun type: energy, ballistic and alien
Shells and energy cells fly out of the gun, bounce and fade
Smoke wisps and a hot-barrel glow when you keep firing
Sparks and dust that match the surface you hit

entries.title: Sector Nine Yard, relit
items: Real baked lighting: sky light, bounce light and soft shadows in every corner
Sharper concrete and metal with real material detail
Grime, oil stains and rust streaks where they belong
A cinematic colour grade (Balanced, High and Ultra; Performance stays as fast as before)

entries.title: New modelled cover in Sector Nine Yard
items: Detailed futuristic walls, barricades, crates and cargo pods

entries.title: New cover in Sector Nine Yard
items: An impounded hover car in the west sniper lane
A NEXUS security checkpoint north of the fortress
An anti-grav forklift west of the fortress

entries.title: New first-person hands
items: Futuristic gloves and sleeves on every gun
They match your soldier skin
The killcam shows your killer's gloves

entries.title: Sharper-looking guns
items: K-7, M-2 and Longbow get new future materials
Clean dot sights on every gun
Smoother aim-down-sights

entries.title: Hits you can feel
items: Enemies flinch where you hit them: heads snap back, bodies twist, legs buckle
Impact bursts that match the soldier: blood mist, alien goo, sparks on robots
Heavier guns knock harder, and the fallen drop away from the shot
All of it in the killcam replay and for online players too
New setting: Low violence (sparks instead of blood, no marks)

entries.title: Smoother game, thanks to you
items: The game now sends one tiny anonymous speed report per match (no names). Turn it off with ?noperf=1

entries.title: Report a bug from inside the game
items: New 'Report a bug' button in the menu and pause menu
Point at the broken spot in the map with your crosshair

entries.title: Friends
items: Add friends and see who is online
Invite friends to your room, or join theirs in one click

entries.title: Game modes: Team Deathmatch and Demolition
items: Team Deathmatch: two teams, first to the kill target wins
Demolition: plant the charge at site A or B, or defuse it, round by round
Free for all stays the classic mode
Already playing? Refresh the page with Ctrl+F5 to get the new modes

entries.title: Sharper graphics
items: Smoother edges and sharper detail
Richer colours and better shading on every map
Four quality levels, picked for your graphics card automatically

entries.title: Full settings menu
items: New Settings screen (main menu and pause menu): gameplay, controls, mouse, crosshair, video and audio
Re-bind any key, separate aim-down-sights mouse speed, invert Y
Build your own crosshair with a live preview and share it with a code
Field of view, brightness, camera shake and colour-blind enemy colours
Separate volume for effects and ambience, louder enemy footsteps option

entries.title: Ceiling bump fix
items: Jumping into a low ceiling no longer throws you out of the room (Temple summit room and every other low ceiling)

entries.title: Our own game server and public rooms
items: Sector Nine now runs on its own game server: a public room list, rooms for 3 to 8 players, the host role moves on if the host leaves, and you reconnect if your connection drops
Smooth movement even when the connection lags, like pro shooters do it
Real ping shown on the scoreboard (Tab)
You can hear enemy footsteps
Pausing is silent everywhere
Editing a room keeps the same invite link
Higher jump

entries.title: Sharper hits and a better killcam
items: Bullets hit exactly what you see, on every map
Killcam shows your killer's real aim: sights, sniper scope, movement and reloads
Bodies fall to the ground when killed in mid-air
Calmer lighting on Temple, Glacier and Shrine

entries.title: All 10 maps rebuilt
items: Every map rebuilt from scratch, each with its own layout, size and landmarks
Wallbangs: shoot through thin walls, pods and crates (damage depends on thickness)
No more freezes in the middle of a match
